**Functional summary:** This 275-aa protein is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt protein **B1I5Z0** from *Desulforudis audaxviator*. It is annotated as **spermidine synthase** (polyamine aminopropyltransferase; **EC 2.5.1.16**), in the spermidine-biosynthesis pathway. It transfers an aminopropyl group from decarboxy-S-adenosylmethionine to putrescine, forming spermidine and 5′-methylthioadenosine.

**Properties:** Estimated mass **31.2 kDa**, theoretical pI **5.88**, and GRAVY **−0.16**. The reference annotation places it in the cytoplasm and describes it as a homodimer or homotetramer.
